repo: Phase 22 is named 'performance-baselines-completion' — branch slug is feat/phase-22-performance-baselines-completion
All 3 plans (22-01, 22-02, 22-03) fall in wave 1 (no dependencies between them), enabling full parallel execution
GSD branching strategy for this project is 'phase' — one branch per phase
workflow: GSD commits should go to a feature branch (feat/phase-{N}-{slug}), not directly to main — the planning workflow does not enforce this automatically
When planning commits land on main before pushing, they can be rescued with: create branch at current HEAD, then git reset --hard origin/main
The GSD init tool returns a pre-computed branch_name; if the branch already exists from a prior step, just check it out rather than re-creating
